dex.text: Waddles along the clifftop in a smart coat, like a waiter who has been to sea. Takes its little bill rather seriously.
dex.fact: Atlantic puffins nest in burrows, and they can carry a dozen or more small fish at once in their beaks.

dex.text: Painted for a party it never got invited to. Its bright bill is the most dressed-up thing on the whole cliff.
dex.fact: Puffins shed the bright plates on their bills after the breeding season, then grow them back in spring.
